findings.result: All nine public pages use the audit's page-specific titles with the brand once. Absolute metadata titles prevent the layout template from repeating the brand. Repeated branding in CMS titles is also normalized.
Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and Disclaimer have their own accurate descriptions and share-preview summaries.
Every public page declares one absolute self-canonical. Inquiry parameters are excluded and legacy CMS canonicals cannot point a distinct public page to the homepage.
The XML sitemap contains the nine final indexable public URLs, without fragments, form endpoints or fabricated modification dates.
A plain-text robots.txt permits public crawling and declares the sitemap. Admin routes are excluded.
The logo and hero masters are substantially smaller. Next.js serves responsive modern-format variants. High-resolution originals are retained outside public/ for reproducible optimization.

responsiveSamples.environment: Local production Next.js image optimizer; Accept: image/avif,image/webp,*/*; quality 75

findings.result: The original 33 public static-image slots have dimension attributes and responsive delivery. The decorative hero is an additional responsive fill image within an explicitly sized section. Descriptive alt text is retained.
Both eight-service lists use ListItem wrappers with position on the wrapper and Service inside item. Providers reference the stable LocalBusiness ID.
Main-content heading levels follow H1/H2/H3. Homepage trust-strip labels use paragraphs, and service cards follow a descriptive H2 parent.
Placeholder social icons are hidden. Only confirmed profile URLs should be added to SOCIAL_LINKS in lib/seo.ts.
The homepage testimonial section is hidden when no real published testimonials exist. No reviews or ratings were invented.
The homepage uses the audit's neutral pricing headline and adjacent provider-dependent qualifications. Casket wording asks which burial plans include a casket and explains that inclusions vary.

opportunities.result: All eight services have fuller planning guidance. Homepage cards and footer labels link to the corresponding service sections. About, Contact and Booking have contextual service links; forms have nearby privacy links. Sticky-header anchor offsets are included.

Published founder information and the scope of planning guidance are clarified. Provider delivery and provider-specific terms are explained without inventing credentials or affiliations. LocalBusiness is retained with a stable ID, founder, phone, service area and city-level address.
opportunities.clientNeeded: Any formal provider relationship, license or credential, verified experience, additional served communities and genuine public office address.

opportunities.result: Existing automatic translation was exercised in a local browser. Separate Spanish search pages and hreflang were not added because no reviewed Spanish content or Spanish-search decision was supplied.
opportunities.clientNeeded: Confirm Spanish organic-search scope and supply or approve substantive translations before publishing stable Spanish URLs and reciprocal hreflang.

opportunities.result: Each public page has Open Graph and Twitter metadata with its own title, description and URL. The working shared preview image is 1200x630.

Audit-proposed titles, descriptions and descriptive H1s are applied. Legacy seeded metadata and generic hero headings migrate only while they match known old defaults; customized content is preserved.

Contact explains follow-up. Booking clearly requests a consultation and treats date/time as preferences. Shirt inquiries carry their selected interest into the contact form, including after client navigation. Shirt copy explains what to ask before ordering.
opportunities.clientNeeded: Confirmed shirt sizes, materials, quantities, proof approval, turnaround, pricing, pickup/shipping options and any consultation duration, format, cost or response-time promise.

additionalChanges: About video has a 1274x720 poster and relevant text context; controls, playsInline and preload=metadata are retained.
Military-themed casket examples are distinguished from military funeral honors and veterans' benefits.
A time-relative date reference was removed from the fallback founder story.
Reduced-motion and pre-hydration content visibility was repaired and covered by a regression test.
Concurrent page/metadata requests share one seeding operation. Failed initialization can retry, and legacy service descriptions migrate without overwriting custom text.
Unexpected, inherited-property and repeated inquiry parameters safely fall back to an unselected interest.

verification.browser: Six commercial pages passed at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844, including reduced-motion visibility, image loading, navigation, anchor scrolling and locally intercepted form interactions

performance.pages: Six commercial pages plus Privacy Policy, on mobile and desktop
performance.limit: Local production build with public seed fixtures; standard simulated mobile throttling and the Lighthouse desktop preset. Third-party translation was blocked for deterministic measurement. These are lab results, not production field Core Web Vitals.
